units.source_text: 此时风声稍紧，夜色渐深，室内无声，想见二人正已入睡，头中将便悄悄地走进室内。

en.t: By this time the wind had grown a little stronger, the night had deepened, and the room was silent; thinking that the two inside must already be asleep, To no Chujo quietly entered the room.

units.source_text: 源氏公子心绪不宁，不能放怀就睡，立刻听见了足音。

en.t: Prince Genji was uneasy and could not simply relax and fall asleep, so he heard the footsteps at once.

units.source_text: 他想不到头中将会来此，猜度这是以前和内侍私通的那个修理大夫，不忘旧情，重来探访。

en.t: He never imagined that To no Chujo would come there, and guessed instead that it was the Master of Repairs who had once had a secret affair with the Naishi, returning to visit because he had not forgotten their old attachment.

units.source_text: 他想：我这种不伦不类的行径，被这个老练的人看到了，多难为情！

en.t: He thought, How embarrassing it would be if this experienced man saw me behaving in such an improper and absurd way!

units.source_text: 便对内侍说：“哎呀，不好了，让我回去吧。

en.t: So he said to the Naishi, Oh no, this is bad. Please let me go back.

units.source_text: 你早已看见了蟢子飞[\[19\]](#part1336.html#m19)，却瞒过我，太刻毒了！”

en.t: You had already seen the house spider flying [\[19\]](#part1336.html#m19), but you kept it from me. How cruel of you!

units.source_text: 便起身光拿了一件常礼服，躲进屏风背后去了。

en.t: Then he got up, took only a single everyday court robe, and slipped behind the screen to hide.
